# Progress

`ui.progress` · parts: `Progress` · elements: `<progress>`

## Purpose

Progress is native task progress (value/max); omit value for indeterminate.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Progress yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Progress renders a native progress element; children are the fallback text.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Value` | `value` | `value` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Max` | `max` | `max` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaLabel` | `aria-label` | `aria-label` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-label` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-label` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `progressClasses({ ... })` from `progress/progress.shared.ts` |
| templ | `progress.ProgressClasses(progress.ProgressProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('progressClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::progressClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `progress_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<progress>Content</progress>` |
| value | `{"Value":"30","Max":"100","AriaLabel":"Upload"}` | `<progress value="30" max="100" aria-label="Upload">Content</progress>` |

## Usage

Fixture `value` (`{"Value":"30","Max":"100","AriaLabel":"Upload"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<progress value="30" max="100" aria-label="Upload">Content</progress>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Progress } from "./ui/progress/progress";

<Progress value="30" max="100" aria-label="Upload">Content</Progress>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Progress from "./ui/progress/Progress.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Progress value="30" max="100" aria-label="Upload">Content</Progress>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Progress from "./ui/progress/Progress.svelte";
</script>

<Progress value="30" max="100" aria-label="Upload">Content</Progress>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Progress } from "./ui/progress/progress.solid";

<Progress value="30" max="100" aria-label="Upload">Content</Progress>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderProgress } from "./ui/progress/progress.wc";

document.body.append(renderProgress({ value: "30", max: "100", "aria-label": "Upload" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/progress"

@progress.Progress(progress.ProgressProps{Value: "30", Max: "100", AriaLabel: "Upload"}) { Content }
```

```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))
